notes.subject: שדוד/נשדנו
notes.rationale: Poelelo ya motso o mong — shadad — e hapileng ka bobedi, e timetswe ka tlhaloso e kholo Sesothong.

notes.subject: חלק/יחלק
notes.rationale: chelek (karolo) le chalaq (ho arola ka masele) — mantswe a tshwanang ka lentswe, ka bobedi a na le maikutlo a ho arola le ho khaola lefatshe.

notes.subject: לשובב
notes.rationale: Lishovav: 'moputsoothi/moqheketsi' (ASV, YLT) kgahlano le 'ho busetsa' (JPS: 'ho se buse masimo') kgahlano le 'moqheketsi' (BSB: 'mahlahana').

notes.subject: שדוד נשדנו
notes.rationale: Tekano e sa feleng: 're sotloa ka ho felletseng' kgahlano le 're sotloa' feela; masale a mabedi a Seheberu a hlakang ho tiisa taba.

translation: Ka letsatsi leo ba tla nosa holimo ea lona masale, mme ba lla taolelo ya lico, ba re: Re sotloa ka ho felletseng; o fetotse karolo ea setjhaba sa ka; o ntlohotlisa joang! Ho moputsoothi o arola masimo a rona.
